name: cocos-slot-mcp
framing: newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdio or one JSON-RPC object per HTTP POST
tier: mixed (read-only tools plus one opt-in write tool)

tools.name: editor_status
tools.description: Check the live Editor bridge and project identity without accessing or modifying scenes.

tools.name: project_map
tools.description: Discover likely Cocos Creator project roots, creator version, actual npm scripts, and bounded game-like subdirectories.

tools.name: resolve_game
tools.description: Resolve a 4-digit game id to all matching directories under the project root; never guesses on ambiguous matches.

tools.name: scene_inspect
tools.description: Parse a .scene/.prefab JSON file and return bounded node/component counts, node names/paths, and parse errors.

tools.name: asset_refs_check
tools.description: Inspect __uuid__ asset references in a scene/prefab and report refs unresolved against the .meta asset index.

tools.name: es5_scan
tools.description: Scan source files for constructs banned by the repo cross-profile ES5-safety rule.

tools.name: module_triple_check
tools.description: Inspect a Module/Data/Config file group for naming pattern and onDestroy cleanup evidence.

tools.name: scene_query_node_tree
tools.description: Read the live scene node hierarchy (uuid, name, path, parent/child links) through the companion Editor extension. Requires Editor; no scene mutation or save.

tools.name: scene_query_node_components
tools.description: Read bounded serialized component summaries from a saved scene/prefab. Requires scenePath and exactly one nodePath or nodeUuid; optional projectPath and maxComponents (default 50, clamped 1..200). No live Editor access.

tools.name: scene_query_components_catalog
tools.description: Read a bounded saved scene/prefab component-reference catalog in deterministic type/node/component order. Requires scenePath; optional projectPath, case-insensitive substring typeFilter, and maxResults (default 200, clamped 1..1000). No live Editor access.

tools.name: scene_batch_node_properties
tools.description: Read bounded safe properties from a saved scene/prefab for ordered node selectors with individual errors. Requires scenePath and nodes (each exactly one nodePath or nodeUuid); optional projectPath, properties (first 50), and maxNodes (default 100, clamped 1..500). No live Editor access.

tools.name: module_triple_wiring_check_live
tools.description: Audit live Module components that provably call getComponent() on a naming-convention-compatible Config identifier in their own source; naming alone is never evidence. Modules without that call are skipped (skipped[], reason no_config_dependency_in_source) — known limitation: a Module depending on a differently-named/shared Config is also skipped, not flagged. Among audited modules: missing Config is error; missing Data is warn. Healthy modules are counted; unresolved CIDs are not guessed. No per-game whitelist. Never modifies or saves scenes.

tools.name: scene_missing_refs_live
tools.description: Inspect bounded live component properties for missing asset UUID references through the Editor asset database. Deduplicates lookups, excludes __id__ links, and reports truncation; unavailable names and expected types remain null. Never modifies or saves scenes.

tools.name: scene_create_node
tools.description: Create ONE empty node live in the open Editor scene hierarchy via the companion extension's create-node IPC. Disabled by default: the project owner must create a .mcp-control/mcp-write-enabled sentinel file in the Cocos project to allow it. Never saves the scene; every call requires confirm:true and the change is undoable with Ctrl+Z in the Editor.
